judgment_refs.note: Actual driver observation requires original driver-view and independent source review; camera visibility and requested control do not prove perception.
The qualitative legal standard requires later independent judgment; requested speed and diagnostic motion are raw evidence only.

sweep_specs.rationale: Original driver observation and the qualitative proper-caution standard are not fixed by a controller speed contrast; physical sweep coverage remains to be authored without a legal cutoff.
missing_inputs: Original source evidence of driver observation and each statutory position
Source-backed feasible range and spacing for a physical controller sweep
